description.value: The Collingwood Branch is one of the Vancouver Public Library's neighbourhood locations, situated on the busy Kingsway corridor in East Vancouver. It occupies a two-storey retail building and serves the surrounding Collingwood and Renfrew communities with free public library services. For a touring cyclist, it offers a publicly accessible urban rest stop with the resources of a full library branch.
